pages.en:
Where responsibility lies. Whether something is right or wrong.

Losing Sakura weighs more heavily than being pursued by any of those questions.

…There was never any need to make a grand decision.

I simply want to protect Sakura.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Where the responsibility lies, existence of good and evil.
Losing Sakura will weigh more heavily on me than either of those things.
…I don’t even need to think about it.
I just want to protect Sakura, that’s all.

pages.en:
I told myself she was only my underclassman and tried never to think of her as a woman.

Because I wanted her beside me, I went on deceiving myself that way.

But the situation has passed beyond the reach of such excuses.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I tried to see her as just another fellow student.
I kept on deceiving myself because I wanted her to stay by my side.
But such deception will no longer work.

今はそれだけ。
何も考えられないのなら、唯一確かなその気持ちを信じるだけだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
——Shirou Emiya does not want to lose Sakura Matou.

For now, that is all.

If I can think of nothing else, then I will trust the one feeling I know to be true.
pages.mirrorMoon:

That’s all.
If I can’t think things through, I’ll just have to trust in the only definite feeling I have.

*If you mean to save one person, and one alone——*

I cannot drive away Archer's words, prophetic as a curse.
